title: Matterbridge Dynalite plugin
description: matterbridge-dynalite: Philips Dynalite lights and heating, straight from the Ethernet gateway

gateways.title: Gateways
gateways.description: One entry per Dynalite Ethernet gateway (PDEG, DDNG and similar).

name.title: Name
name.description: A short name, unique among the gateways. It is part of every device's identity: changing it later makes the devices new to your controller.

host.title: Address
host.description: The gateway's IP address or host name, with :port if its web server is not on 80 (443 with HTTPS).

allowSelfSigned.title: Accept a self-signed certificate
allowSelfSigned.description: With HTTPS: accept the gateway's own certificate.

username.title: Username
username.description: Only if the gateway asks for HTTP authentication.

dynetPort.title: DyNet TCP port (live updates)
dynetPort.description: A TCP server port set up on the gateway (connection Trunk, DyNet 1 or DyNet2), e.g. 50000. Changes made anywhere — wall panels, timers, other apps — then show at once. Leave empty to rely on polling. If another program already uses that port, give this plugin a port of its own.

pollMinutes.title: Read every area every … minutes
pollMinutes.description: A check when live updates are on (60 by default); the only source of state without them (5 by default).

fadeSeconds.title: Fade (seconds)
fadeSeconds.description: The fade for commands from Matter that do not give one.

channels.title: Channels (lights)
channels.description: Each channel becomes its own light. Leave empty to show the area as one light switched by its presets.

name.title: Name
name.description: The area's name and the channel number if left empty.

dimmable.title: Dimmable
dimmable.description: Off for a relay that only switches.

whiteList.title: White list
whiteList.description: Only expose these devices (by name or id). Leave empty for all.

blackList.title: Black list
blackList.description: Do not expose these devices (by name or id).

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister on shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Remove all devices from the bridge when the plugin stops (for development).
